{{Quote|What happened? Where's the droid?''"<br />"''The droid's gone. But there's good news: the Jedi's unarmed.''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"''It doesn't look like he has his lightsaber.|Shahan Alama, reporting back to Bane during the raid on the Senate|audio=GoodNewsNoLightsaber.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
'''Shahan Alama''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After being kicked out of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang, he was recruited alongside fellow [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to see how well they would work together. Bane decided to task them with the capture of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Davtokk]], and the trio successfully carried out their mission. Bane, impressed with their teamwork, formed the three into his new posse, and they traveled to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|attempt to free]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic prison]].

During the raid, the bounty hunters captured several [[Senator/Legends|senators]], holding them hostage in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] to force [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to free Ziro. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was present in the Senate Building and attempted to foil the bounty hunters' plan, but Alama, Sing, and Robonino managed to find and incapacitate him. Palpatine agreed to free Ziro, and after the Hutt was released, the bounty hunters escaped with Ziro, leaving a system of explosives in the atrium to use the senators as leverage for their escape. Afterward, Bane ordered his posse to go into hiding. Alama traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], where he was [[Battle of Florrum|attacked]] first by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate (Florrum)|frigate]] and then by nearby [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces. He was forced to crash-land on Florrum, where he found the Weequay pirate [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], who intended to hold him for ransom.

==Biography==
===Recruitment===
{{Quote|This&hellip;this was a test?''"<br />"''Yes. But not yours. A test of my colleagues. They're solitary types and I need a team. I am happy to say they passed&hellip;by ensuring that you ''failed''.|Davtokk and Cad Bane, referring to Alama and the other recruits|<ref name="Invitation Only">''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]''</ref>}}
Shahan Alama was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. He was a member of a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] but was eventually deemed too nasty and kicked out, earning him a bad reputation among other pirates. At some point during his career, he stole a belt from a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]],<ref name="TCWCE" /> and by approximately [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> he had the [[Limb/Legends|arm]] of a [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droid]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|grafted]] onto his right elbow.<ref name="TCWCE" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Alama, along with the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], was recruited by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to see how well they would work as a team.<ref name="Invitation Only" />

Bane hoped to use them in his upcoming mission to free the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Ziro had been placed in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] for his role in the kidnapping of his great-nephew, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> and Bane had been hired by the Hutts to free him<ref name="DB Cad Bane">{{DB|character|cadbane|Bane, Cad}}</ref>&mdash;but first he wanted to assess the hunters' ability to work together. Bane decided to test the trio by having them capture the bounty hunter [[Davtokk]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Keyorin]]. The Duros convinced Davtokk to come to Keyorin by telling him that he needed recruits, although Bane knew that the hunter would betray him for the large bounty on the Duros's head. When Davtokk arrived on Keyorin, he met Bane in an explosives-wired building and abruptly shot him, only to find that what he had shot was actually a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] mannequin of Bane.<ref name="Invitation Only" />

[[File:Almost_commendable.png|thumb|left|250px|Alama, Sing, and Robonino, with a defeated Davtokk]]
Davtokk was instantly ambushed by Robonino, who detonated the building's explosives, forcing the hunter outside. Alama was waiting for him and quickly caught him in a [[razor net]]. The hunter managed to break free and use a [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash grenade]] to evade the onrushing Weequay, but Davtokk was abruptly shot through the knees by [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]] from Sing. Bane then arrived on the scene and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Davtokk. Pleased with the trio's performance, Bane took his new posse to Coruscant<ref name="Invitation Only" /> to prepare for the operation to rescue Ziro. Bane's plan was to capture several [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and hold them hostage, using them as leverage to force [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to free Ziro.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

===Raid on the Senate===
{{Quote|You have two more floors to check.''"<br />"''Come on. We've got two more floors to check.|Skywalker uses a mind trick on Alama|audio=TwoMoreFloorsToCheck.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
The [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|mission]] began as Bane and Alama, along with two [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and an [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]], landed at the entrance to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]. As they were confronted by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], a unit within the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], Sing attacked the squad with sniper fire from a nearby building, and the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were quickly eliminated. Sing and Robonino flew down to the entrance in another airspeeder with several more [[sentinel droid]]s. Leaving the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] commandos outside, Alama, Sing, Robonino, Bane, and the sentinel droids entered the Executive Building. Robonino stayed in the building's [[Power control room/Legends|power control room]] to shut down the building's power, while the others continued to the [[Senate East Wing/Legends|East Wing]], sabotaging the Senate Guards' barracks along the way. The group reached the atrium, which was filled with several senators who had gathered to discuss the [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]]. The bounty hunters quickly surrounded them, taking them hostage. With the captives secured, Bane contacted Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and requested that Ziro be released. As Palpatine refused, Robonino successfully shut down the building's power and activated the emergency lockdown, trapping Palpatine and Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's office]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;who had been spending time in the Senate Building with his secret [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], when the attack began&mdash;found the senators being held hostage and spied on the events taking place. Noticing Skywalker, Bane opened fire on the Jedi, who quickly took off running. Recognizing the Jedi as a potential threat to the mission, Bane sent Alama and a [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid (Cad Bane)/Legends|sentinel droid]] after him. As they searched the building, Alama and the droid heard Skywalker in a room, speaking with Palpatine via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The Jedi hid before they walked in and proceeded to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on the Weequay to get the pair to leave. After Alama and the sentinel droid split up to continue the search, Skywalker attacked the droid; but since he had earlier given his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to Amidala, he was forced to engage the droid in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

[[File:Shahan_Alama.png|thumb|right|225px|Alama, while searching for Anakin Skywalker]]
By the time Alama returned to the scene, Skywalker had escaped, but after examining the droid's remains, Alama deduced that the Jedi was not in possession of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Alama reported this finding to Bane and continued the search with the help of Sing. They found Skywalker trying to break into the power control room, but the Jedi [[Telekinesis/Legends|pulled]] Alama's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] out of his hand before the Weequay could shoot. Alama suddenly ducked, and Sing, who had been standing right behind him, took aim at the Jedi, shooting Alama's blaster out of Skywalker's hand. Robonino ambushed the Jedi from behind, shocking him and knocking him out, and the hunters put the unconscious Jedi in [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]] and took him to Bane.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

Palpatine, meanwhile, finally agreed to give a [[Pardon disc/Legends|pardon disc]] to Senator Taa, who was to deliver the disc to the prison so that Ziro could be released. Sentinel droid [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] then escorted the freed Hutt back to the Executive Building, where Bane, Alama, and the team set up a system of lasers around the hostage senators that, if triggered, would set off explosives and detonate the entire atrium. Bane held an alternate detonator for the explosives and used it as leverage to ensure his team's escape. As they flew away, Bane activated the explosives as payback for the indignities that Ziro suffered while in prison, but Skywalker, who had awoken and retrieved his lightsaber from Amidala, was able to save the senators.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

===On the run===
{{Quote|Where's the ''rest'' of it, Bane?''"<br />"''To the ''point'', Alama, I admire that. Careful that I don't admire it so much, I take your tongue as a keepsake.|Alama and Bane, on the money reward|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part I)]]</ref>}}
[[File:Alama_crashed.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Alama, after crashing on Florrum]]
Shortly after the bounty hunters escaped, Alama revealed that he didn't trust Bane to hand over his share of the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Bane ordered Alama and the other hunters to temporarily go into hiding, and the Weequay traveled out to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|his ''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]]. Over the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], he ran into Confederate forces under the command of a [[Unidentified Neimoidian captain|Neimoidian captain]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]], believing Alama to be a pirate, ordered his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to open fire on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Alama began to head for Florrum's surface, but Republic forces stationed nearby arrived on the scene and [[Battle of Florrum|defeated]] the Confederates before going on to attack Alama, shooting him down. The Weequay crash-landed his [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|ship]] on the planet, where he found fellow Weequay [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], who was the leader of a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|group of pirates]]. Ohnaka then suggested that he would hold Alama captive and give him to whomever was willing to pay him the most.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|No lightsaber cuts&hellip;Interesting.|Alama, upon finding the destroyed sentinel droid|audio=NoLightsaberCuts.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
Alama usually preferred to work alone,<ref name="Invitation Only" /> but he also worked well with other such solitary beings.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> His "excessive nastiness" caused his membership in a pirate gang to be revoked and earned him a reputation as a bad pirate.<ref name="TCWCE" /> The Weequay had a sense of self-confidence about him and was not afraid of confronting Anakin Skywalker, a well-known Jedi Knight. However, Alama proved to be vulnerable to certain [[The Force/Legends|Force]] effects, as Skywalker was able to employ a mind trick on the Weequay.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> Still, Alama was also observant; during investigations of the sentinel droid that Skywalker had destroyed, he noticed instantly that the droid bore no lightsaber marks. From this observation, Alama quickly came to the conclusion that Skywalker was unarmed.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> After the bounty hunters escaped with Ziro, Bane told them all to go into hiding. He promised that he'd take care of distributing their earnings, and although Alama didn't trust Bane to do this, he left without his share of the bounty.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" />

Alama was a highly skilled tracker, a competent [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and a proficient gunman;<ref name="TCWCE" /> and he acquitted himself as a bounty hunter who was quick with a blaster.<ref name="Stand Aside">''[[The Clone Wars: Stand Aside - Bounty Hunters!]]''</ref> For weaponry, Alama carried a [[Weequay blaster pistol/Legends|Weequay blaster pistol]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], and a razor net, and he often wore a [[red]] beret that he had saved from his tenure as a pirate. He also wore [[Boot/Legends|boots]] of [[Nerf-hide/Legends|nerf-hide]], a belt that he had stolen from a Twi'lek noble, and a combat droid arm that was grafted on his right elbow.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Who invited Shahan into this lineup?|[[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]|<ref name="CWIII">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>}}
Shahan Alama made his first appearance in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only|''Invitation Only'']], which led directly into "[[Hostage Crisis]]," the final episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, in which Alama also appeared. In the episode, Alama was portrayed by voice actor [[Corey Burton]]. Shahan Alama was first identified by name in the episode guide of "Hostage Crisis" on [[StarWars.com]],<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}}</ref> though he was named "Filonebal" in writer [[Eoghan Mahony]]'s original script for the episode.<ref name="Insider 116: Classic Moment">{{InsiderCite|116|Classic Moment|Classic Moment: Enter Cad Bane}}</ref> Alama later appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)]]'',<ref name="CWHH1">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part I)]]</ref> and he also received an entry in [[2010]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TCWCE" />Alama was pictured in ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', and in the acknowledgments of the book a "Shahana Alam" was listed.<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> In [[2011]], Alama received a non-[[canon]]ical appearance in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', appearing as a playable character in the game's adaptation of "Hostage Crisis."<ref name="CWIII" /> He also appeared in the non-canon book [[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles (book)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles'' book]] Aurra Sing mentioned him in a quote in the "Best Bounty Hunters" section.<ref name="TYCB">[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles (book)|''LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles'' book]]</ref>
